newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Inapa sees 2 bln esc net '97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Inapa sees 2 bln esc net '97.

text.p: Portuguese paper firm Inapa-Investimentos, Participacoes e Gestao expects to post a consolidated net profit of about two billion escudos in 1997 and sales of around 60 billion escudos, its president Vasco Pessanha said.
"We think the results (consolidated net profit) in 1997 should double those of 1996," Vasco Pessanha told reporters.
Inapa's 1996 profits rose 200 percent year-on-year to 1.053 billion escudos, while sales fell 18 percent to 40.5 billion escudos.
Vasco Pessanha said Inapa's production was expected to rise to 240,000 tonnes in 1997 from 180,000 tonnes in 1996.
He said he expected revenues from paper production to stand at about 40 billion escudos this year, up from 25.6 billion in 1996.
